## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link issues or affected record IDs.

## Validation

and material limits; include UI evidence when relevant.
Run `./scripts/ci.sh` locally and report its result; explicitly note if
`--no-docker` was used. GitHub does not run CI for this repository.

## Documentation

Remove unused sections. Do not attach credentials, account/catalog dumps or
authenticated headers.
